claim_scope: Sanitized operator-authorized local live-provider comparison. Prompts, full responses, credentials, user identifiers, and raw tool outputs are not retained in this artifact.

rubric.review: Independent model review with representative URL validation; response contents treated as untrusted data.

review_notes: Single cited four reachable authoritative sources.
Team emitted four inert tool-call-shaped JSON blocks as answer text.
Two of Team's four cited URLs returned 404 during review.
Team was more precise about Temporal activity delivery, Celery acknowledgment semantics, and PostgreSQL crash recovery.
Both contained minor unsupported or insufficiently cited claims.
Single supplied the more operationally complete rollout protocol.
Both answers contained weak, unverifiable, or likely fabricated citations.
Team added useful statistical ideas but did not overcome its citation-quality deficit.

tuning_evidence: The initial 45-second child and 75-second aggregate deadlines caused live child timeouts.
Increasing time alone exposed tool-call and token-budget exhaustion.
The final configuration bounds tool-result text, signs that bound into the delegation envelope, and keeps Team parent synthesis tool-free.
Aborted tuning runs are diagnostic evidence, not acceptance passes.
limitations: Three paired cases are diagnostic acceptance evidence, not a statistically powered benchmark.
Team was slower in all three cases and did not beat Single on reviewed quality.
The local backend container did not expose the source repository as a child workspace, so repository-grounded prompts were excluded from the final paired comparison.
The Agents inspector reload path remains deterministically tested; this evidence packet does not claim an authenticated browser reload using one of the ephemeral live-evaluation identities.
No public deployment, multi-instance behavior, production SLO, parallel fan-out, or parent-wide atomic budget reservation is demonstrated.
